description: This file defines the UpdateKernel class used in Drupal for handling update-related requests, including environment setup, session management, access control, and request handling specific to Drupal's update process.

classes.name: UpdateKernel
classes.description: A specialized Drupal kernel used for executing Drupal updates, managing environment setup, request handling, session management, and access control during update operations.

methods.name: discoverServiceProviders
methods.description: Overrides parent method to add the update kernel service provider.

methods.name: initializeContainer
methods.description: Forces container rebuild to override services during update.

methods.name: cacheDrupalContainer
methods.description: Prevents caching of the update container to avoid leakage into the main site.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main request handler that initializes environment, manages session, and processes the update request.

methods.name: handleRaw
methods.description: Executes the core logic of update.php, including access check and invoking the update controller.

methods.name: bootSession
methods.description: Starts the session to simulate Drupal's session middleware.

methods.name: shutdownSession
methods.description: Saves the session at the end of request processing.

methods.name: setupRequestMatch
methods.description: Sets up fake routing data for update.php to enable batch API.

methods.name: handleAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the update page; throws exception if not.
